reader_summary.headline: Ashby Monk is the Executive and Research Director of the Stanford Research Initiative on Long-Term Investing.
reader_summary.overview: Ashby Monk is the Executive and Research Director of the Stanford Research Initiative on Long-Term Investing. Over the last two decades, Ashby has worked closely with some of the world's largest sovereign wealth funds and pension funds on governance, organizational design, technology. He is also a co-founder of KDX Management, a venture capital firm focused on investech, a co-founder of several startups in the space.
